fields.i_receive: Galileu reviews our R$842,000 claim superficially

narrative_summary: Lawyers offer Galileu a superficial review and discover that invisible ink has very visible legal consequences.
rationale: Candidate 4 best exploits the Trade Offer format: the promised superficial review is cleanly countered by a specific, costly legal consequence. It includes the case’s key figures and the white-on-white prompt injection without merely restating the premise.
